title: Discovery
label: UNDERSTAND
description: Every project starts with understanding the problem. I define requirements, user flows, project scope, and technical constraints before writing a single line of code.

title: UI / UX Design
label: DESIGN
description: Ideas are translated into intuitive digital experiences through information architecture, wireframes, visual systems, and interactive prototypes.

title: Architecture
label: PLAN
description: The right technology is selected based on the product requirements. I design the application architecture, database structure, API contracts, and system flow.

title: Development
label: BUILD
description: Frontend, backend, authentication, database, integrations, and business logic are built into a modular and maintainable system.

title: Testing
label: REFINE
description: The application is tested, optimized, and hardened. Performance, accessibility, security, API behavior, and edge cases are continuously checked.

title: Deployment
label: SHIP
description: The finished application moves from local development to production through containerization, CI/CD, server configuration, HTTPS, and monitoring.
